name: Kujou Miriya
source:
A freshman belonging to the Faculty of Education at R University. 

She acts as a diligent student, but her overly serious attitude causes [url=https://vndb.org/c93026]Akito[/url] to look at her with suspicion.

She has a vivacious and outspoken personality. Later on, she and Akito pursue a case together.

[Translated from [url=http://creo.main.jp/page/product/loot/Character/loot_cha_miriya.html]official website[/url]]
